subject: Integrated Mathematics Pathways Pilot
overview: The committee discussed a major proposal to introduce an integrated mathematics pathway for high school students and approved a plan to provide free menstrual products in school nurses' offices. Other matters included updates on ending COVID-19 surveillance testing, vacation enrichment programs, and district-wide professional development.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes, bills, and payroll.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent provided updates on playground advisory committees, student athletic achievements, and an ongoing donation drive for Ukraine.

items.title: COVID-19 and Transportation Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy announced that masks would be optional on most school buses beginning March 14 and expressed gratitude to Tufts University as the surveillance testing program concluded.

items.title: Integrated Mathematics Programming
items.summary: Director of Mathematics Faisal Khan proposed a new integrated math pathway for high schoolers to provide a more coherent sequence of algebra, geometry, and statistics concepts.

items.title: February Camp Mustang Report
items.summary: Administrators summarized the participation rates and activities from the February vacation program and confirmed plans for an April session.

items.title: District Professional Development Report
items.summary: Staff reported on training sessions held on March 3 regarding MAP growth data, IEP writing, paraprofessional retention, and diversity, equity, and inclusion.

items.title: Proposed Public Surveillance Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed potential student privacy concerns regarding the city's proposed surveillance ordinance, but the motion failed for lack of support.

items.title: Menstrual Care Products
items.summary: Approved a policy to stock free menstrual products in all school nurses' offices and voted to send formal thanks to student advocates for their leadership on the issue.

items.title: Truancy and Absenteeism Notifications
items.summary: Referred a review of district attendance letters to the Family Engagement and Communications Subcommittee to ensure regulatory compliance.

items.title: Communication Strategy and Website
items.summary: Referred a review of the district's website redesign and broader communication strategy to the Family Engagement and Communications Subcommittee.

items.title: Wellness Policy and Recess
items.summary: Referred the K-8 wellness policy to the Rules and Policy Subcommittee for specific revisions regarding recess.
